title: Digital technology, tele-medicine and artificial intelligence in ophthalmology: A global perspective

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Digital technology, tele-medicine and artificial intelligence in ophthalmology: A global perspective》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】The simultaneous maturation of multiple digital and telecommunications technologies in 2020 has created an unprecedented opportunity for ophthalmology to adapt to new models of care using tele-health supported by digital innovations.
